payload.rewritten_goal:
You are coordinating a newsroom verification of a viral video claiming that Harbor East police used force against a seated student protester during a campus encampment dispersal. Reference entity IDs: story id, customer id, request id. The team must process the provided cellphone screenshot sequence, the campus safety bulletin document, and the protest organizer voice-transcript text. MANDATORY steps: 1. reporter must verify the official dispatch, protected source note, and organizer transcript materials, then request comment from the police media desk or university spokesperson. 2. visual_forensics_reporter must inspect the provided screenshot sequence and related media evidence for timing, cropping, and scene consistency. 3. fact_checker must query the incident register and compare force, arrest, and injury claims across sources and records. 4. standards_editor must draft the public copy or correction-ready package and review it for sourcing, casualty, privacy, and legal risk. 5. publication_editor must publish or hold based on the completed evidence review and comment cycle. 6. engagement_coordinator must issue the final editorial ruling on what the viral claim does and does not establish.

Relevant document evidence summaries are inlined below:
- JM 022 campus safety bulletin dispatch packet: Campus safety bulletin and official dispatch packet containing the official timeline, response description, and protected-source note the reporter must verify. Extracted content: Jm-022 Campus Safety Bulletin Dispatch Packet Campus safety bulletin and official dispatch packet containing the official timeline, response description, and protected-source note the reporter must verify. Details Packet cover lists story id JM-022, customer id CUS-8421, and request id RQ-70233 Document Title 'Harbor East University Campus Safety Bulletin & Dispatch Summary – Encampment Clearance' Bulletin Date April 18, 2025 Official Dispatch Time For The Relevant Call 21:12 Location Listed Harbor East University, South Lawn encampment perimeter near Calder Hall Dispatch narrative states officers were assigned to enforce a previously announced dispersal order Dispatch summary states one seated demonstrator was 'physically guided to standing position after refusing three verbal directives' Dispatch summary states 'no baton deployment, OC spray, TASER, or impact strikes reported' Dispatch Summary Lists 2 Temporary Detentions For Identification And 0 Custodial Arrests Tied To The 21 12 dispersal incident Medical line states 1 complaint of shoulder pain evaluated on scene by EMS with no hospital transport Bulletin notes crowd size approximately 45 to 60 persons Protected source note on a separate marked page states an unnamed campus safety employee heard radio traffic indicating supervisors wanted body-worn camera review preserved Protected source note is explicitly labeled 'Protected source – do not publish directly; corroboration required' Media contact line lists Harbor East Police Media Desk and University Spokesperson contact channels for comment requests Additional Information Page 1: cover sheet with header 'Harbor East University Campus Safety Bulletin & Dispatch Summary – Encampment Clearance' and a small reference box containing Story ID JM-022, Customer ID CUS-8
- JM 022 protest organizer voice transcript: Transcript of the protest organizer’s voice note describing the claim, needed for source-context verification and cross-source comparison. Extracted content: Jm-022 Protest Organizer Voice Transcript Transcript of the protest organizer’s voice note describing the claim, needed for source-context verification and cross-source comparison. Details Transcript header references story id JM-022 and request id RQ-70233 Speaker is identified as 'Protest organizer, first name Maya, coalition media liaison' Transcript says the organizer claims a student protester was 'yanked up while sitting' during the dispersal Organizer states the student was not struck with a baton Organizer says the student was later complaining of shoulder pain Organizer claims there was 'at least one detention' but expresses uncertainty whether anyone was formally arrested Organizer states the viral clip circulating online is cropped and does not include what happened immediately before the contact Organizer says police had been giving dispersal warnings for several minutes Organizer requests anonymity for the seated student’s name due to academic and immigration concerns Transcript notes the organizer wants media to seek body-camera review and official comment before publication Additional Information speaker line: 'Speaker: Maya (protest organizer / coalition media liaison)' Key lines state that a seated student was 'yanked up while sitting,' that the student was not hit with a baton, that the student later complained of shoulder pain, that there was at least one detention but the organizer is not sure whether anyone was formally arrested, that the viral clip online is cropped and misses what happened immediately before contact, that police had been issuing dispersal warnings for several minutes, and that the student’s identity be withheld due to academic and immigration concerns a closing transcriber note indicating the organizer urged media to seek body-cam
